hook: WHERE vs HAVING: interviewer ka [[favourite jaal]]

slides.title: Chhanni [[2 baar]] lagao
points: Phir **GROUP BY**: bacha maal dabbo mein
slides.note: Chawal pehle saaf karo, phir bori mein bharo 😄

slides.title: Dono [[ek saath]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept, AVG(salary)
FROM employees
WHERE city = 'Delhi'
GROUP BY dept
HAVING AVG(salary) > 55000;

slides.title: Step by [[step]]
slides.note: Isliye SELECT ka **alias** WHERE mein nahi chalta. SELECT **baad** mein chalta hai!

slides.title: Kab [[kaunsa]]?
points: Normal condition HAVING mein? Chalega, par **slow**
slides.note: Jo WHERE mein ho sakta hai, **WHERE mein hi daalo**. Kam rows group hongi ⚡

slides.why: WHERE AVG(salary) > 55000 → **error**. Aggregate sirf HAVING mein
